product_overview: CarbonCoin is a blockchain-inspired carbon credit marketplace aiming to democratize access to carbon credit markets for individuals, small landowners, farmers, and local communities by enabling them to monetize their environmental contributions through verified digital carbon credits called Carbon Coins.
core_goals: Democratize access to carbon credit markets for small-scale environmental contributors.
Provide fast, accurate, and AI-powered verification of green assets like trees, plantations, and land using satellite imagery and biometric verification.
Establish a transparent and trustworthy transaction system for issuing, trading, and tracking carbon credits as digital Carbon Coins.
Enable sellers and companies to create profiles, submit verification documents, register and manage green properties, and track their carbon coin wallet and transaction history.
Provide administrative and analytics tools for platform oversight and performance monitoring.
key_features: User Registration & Authentication with secure JWT-based login, profile management, and role-based access control.
Identity Verification (KYC) including selfie and Aadhaar document upload, AI-powered biometric face verification, and status tracking.
Green Property Management supporting CRUD operations on properties with geotagged images, boundary coordinates, and property details.
Carbon Coin System featuring digital wallet management, coin transfer between users, transaction history, leaderboard, and marketplace statistics.
Company Management supporting registration, document upload (logo and registration docs), and profile management.
Admin Features for user management, property oversight, verification approval, and platform analytics dashboard.
File Upload System integrated with Cloudinary for secure image and document storage.
Frontend pages and reusable UI components built with Next.js and React for seamless user experience.
user_flow_summary: Users register as a seller or company via the signup page with required personal and business details.
Sellers upload identity verification documents (selfie and Aadhaar) on the verify-identity page and undergo AI-powered face verification.
Verified sellers register green properties by submitting property details, uploading geotagged images, and defining property boundaries on the property-verification page.
Users monitor their Carbon Coin wallet balances, review transaction histories, and transfer coins to other users through the dashboard.
Companies upload registration documents and manage their profiles for credibility and business purposes.
Administrators monitor users, approve or reject verifications, oversee properties, and review platform analytics via a dedicated admin interface.
validation_criteria: User authentication including registration, login, profile update, and logout functions operate securely with JWT tokens and password hashing.
KYC verification workflow must correctly validate uploaded documents, execute biometric face matching, and update verification status.
Property CRUD operations perform correctly with valid input, including geotagging images and boundary coordinates storage.
Carbon Coin wallet accurately reflects balances, transaction histories are complete, and transfer functionality works only for verified users.
Company registration and document upload features securely handle file storage and profile updates.
Admin features provide correct views and controls for user and property management, as well as verification approval workflows.
File uploads are securely processed using Cloudinary integration and validated at backend.
Frontend UI pages and components render correctly and communicate seamlessly with backend API endpoints.
